content: If the DoIP module receives a diagnostic message with the payload data length in the DoIP header is set to a value bigger than DoIPMaxRequestBytes - 4, than the DoIP module shall send a diagnostic message negative acknowledge message with the diagnostic message negative acknowledge code set to 0x04 as described in chapter 7.3.2.6.3 . Additionally the message shall be discarded.

If the DoIP module receives a diagnostic message with the pay- load data length in the DoIP header is set to a value bigger than DoIPMaxRequest Bytes-4, than the DoIP module shall send a diagnostic message negative acknowl- edge message with the diagnostic message negative acknowledge code set to 0x04 as described in chapter 7.3.2.6.3. Additionally the message shall be discarded.

If the DoIP module receives a diagnostic message with the pay- load data length in the DoIP header is set to a value bigger than DoIPMaxRequest Bytes-4, than the DoIP module shall send a diagnostic message negative acknowl- edge message with the diagnostic message negative acknowledge code set to 0x04. Additionally the message shall be discarded.

If the DoIP module receives a diagnostic message with the pay- load data length in the DoIP header is set to a value bigger than DoIPMaxRequest 42 of 123 Document ID 418: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticOverIP Specification of Diagnostic over IP AUTOSAR CP R22-11 Bytes-4, than the DoIP module shall send a diagnostic message negative acknowl- edge message with the diagnostic message negative acknowledge code set to 0x04. Additionally the message shall be discarded.
